source: Warhammer Quest: Blackstone Fortress — Abominable Intellect encounter cards
note: Tier-4 twists transcribed verbatim from card scans. Inline dice glyphs use the same {name} token convention as enemy-actions.json; {d8} and {d12} have no renderer yet.

twists.text: In this combat, each player can only choose to keep a maximum of three activation dice after making an activation roll – discard any other available activation dice.
Explorers are no longer inspired – flip their character card. Each Explorer loses their inspiration points.

When making an inspiration roll in this combat, that roll must be equal to or less than the highest Wounds value of a single hostile slain by that explorer during their activation, instead of the total combined Wounds value.

In step 2 of each initiative phase, the hostile initiative cards are shuffled and set up first. Then the explorers' initiative cards are shuffled and set up along the remaining spaces of the combat track.
To attempt a gambit in this combat, the player who controls the explorer must spend one activation dice with a value of (4+) instead of any activation dice on their character card.
In this combat, once the destiny roll has been resolved, if there is only 1 available destiny dice, and the value of that dice is 1, each explorer suffers 1 wound.
Each explorer has Defence {d6} in this combat.

In this combat, after the destiny phase, the leader must roll the Blackstone dice; on a 15+ they pick one hostile that was slain during the combat and has not returned to the battlefield, and then deploy them as close to an explorer as possible.
Each time a hostile is slain in this combat, each other hostile heals 1 wound.
Explorers do not receive the benefit of cover in this combat.
In this combat, at the end of the destiny phase, return 1 slain hostile from each hostile group to the battlefield as reinforcements.
In this combat, once the destiny roll has been resolved, if there is only 1 available destiny dice, and the value of that dice is 1, each explorer suffers 1 wound.
Add 5 to all hostile behaviour rolls in this combat (to a maximum of 20).
Each time a hostile is slain in this combat, roll the Blackstone dice; on a 20 that model is not slain and all its wounds are healed instead.

twists.text: In this combat, the cost of any action is increased by 1 for explorers who are adjacent to one or more hostiles, to a maximum cost of 6+. For example, the cost of a (4+) action would be increased to (5+).
Roll the Blackstone dice each time a hostile is slain in this combat, before it is removed from the battlefield; if the result is 18+ one adjacent explorer suffers one wound.
